title: Flood Rescue
description: Members of Mississippi Department of Wildlife, Fisheries and Parks’ Special Response Team along with soldiers and airmen from the Army and Air National Guard participate in realistic flood victim rescue. Patriot South 20 allows participants the opportunity to build partnerships and maintain readiness for future disaster relief missions. (U.S Army National Guard video by Sgt. Shawn Keeton)
keywords: Camp Shelby, MDWFP, MSNG, Patriot South 20
